name: Rolling Start
description: An Independent Living Center: disability-led help with daily living skills, peer support, advocacy, assistive technology referrals and moving from a nursing home back to the community. Any age and any disability; military service is not required.
next_step: Call with your county and goals. Ask about intake, home access, independent living skills or help leaving a facility. Offices in San Bernardino and Victorville. Website: www.rollingstart.com.
constraints: An Independent Living Center is a community support organization, not a residential care facility. Services depend on assessment and availability.
